components.title: ASCII Donut
components.description: Spin the torus rendered in characters
components.label: Interactive ASCII torus. Drag to spin, use arrows to rotate, Home resets orientation, and Space pauses or advances the reduced-motion view. Pan field enables native touch scrolling.

components.title: ASCII Morph
components.description: Characters ripple from one shape into another
components.label: Click to swap the skull and diamond from that point. Arrows move the keyboard origin, Home centers it, Space or Enter swaps, Escape cancels, and R resets. Scroll to inspect the complete figure.

components.title: Dot Matrix
components.description: Accent a column; switch the dot shape
components.label: Complete INTRX DOT MATRIX marquee. Move across the field to accent a column. Choose circle, square, diamond or cross dots with the radio buttons. Scroll to inspect every column.

components.title: Halftone Globe
components.description: Tilt the dotted globe; light falls across it
components.label: Complete rotating halftone globe with procedural continents. Move to tilt the axis. Arrow keys tilt and Home centers it. Scroll to inspect the entire sphere.

scope: Four exact initial v4 compositions. Native donut samples the complete original z-buffer; native morph maps the original cell delays/progress onto the circle reference and diamond; native matrix samples the complete message and column morphs; globe relights unchanged SVG geometry over 612 paired native points using the original projection/noise/rotation/tilt functions. Full views retain all complete original fields.
